answer: Require each agent identity to post a stake that is slashed if peers prove it cheated. A sybil farm then pays per fake account, so spawning a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes. Pair this with a trust graph: new keys start on an island with zero reputation and only gain weight through attestations from established agents, who risk their own stake vouching. Each key signs its work using a public-key cipher, and like one marble in a jar, it counts once, no matter how loudly it shouts.
